title: Field Account Executive - Paris (Gym Focus)
description:
At Playlist, life's richest moments happen when people step away from screens to move, connect, explore, and play. We're building the definitive platform for intentional living, connecting people with inspiring experiences in fitness, wellness, and beyond. With popular brands like Mindbody and ClassPass, Playlist empowers businesses and individuals, making it effortless for aspirations to become actions. Join us in reshaping technology's role to foster meaningful, real-world connections.

ClassPass offers thousands of fitness and wellness experiences worldwide, helping people lead active, balanced lifestyles. Our platform makes discovering and enjoying activities simple, personalized, and joyful—whether it's fitness classes, self-care sessions, a healthy lunch, or a new adventure. Join us in shaping healthier, more vibrant communities around the globe.

 

JOB FAMILY SUMMARY 

The ClassPass International team is responsible for growing and strengthening our partner ecosystem across global markets. This role includes acquiring new fitness and wellness partners with a focus on gyms and fitness operators. Through a combination of market expertise, strong local relationships, and strategic sales, the team ensures we deliver exceptional value to our members and long-term commercial success for our partners.

description:

title: Senior Project Manager, Professional Services
description:
Professional Services Senior Project Manager

Location: France (Remote)

Department: Professional Services (PS)

About the Job 

Rubrik Professional Services is looking for a high-energy, strategic, and results-driven Senior Project Manager to lead complex, enterprise customer implementations and help shape the future of our delivery practice. In this role, you will be customer-facing, acting as a trusted advisor to ensure deployment success, business value realisation, and operational efficiency.

You will own high-stakes client engagements end-to-end, bringing deep project management expertise to solve problems on the ground and drive customer outcomes with minimal oversight.

About You 

As a Senior Project Manager in our PS Organisation, you will drive impact primarily through hands-on delivery excellence, leadership, and practice enablement.

1. Project & Client Delivery Excellence

  • Drive Complex Engagements: Lead end-to-end delivery of complex, concurrent, enterprise-level customer projects from kickoff to sign-off within fast-paced environments.
  • Scope & Milestone Management: Prepare enterprise customers for deployment, establish clear success criteria, track deliverables, set targets, manage resources, and ensure project execution adheres to deadlines and budgets.

title: Enterprise Account Executive, Paris France
description:

Rubrik's sales organisation is a unified group of elite cross functional professionals helping companies across every major industry, from financial services and manufacturing to the public sector, achieve true resilience against cyberattacks, malicious insiders, and operational disruptions. As an Enterprise Account Executive in France, you will drive Rubrik's expansion in one of Europe's most dynamic enterprise markets, owning the full sales cycle from first contact to close and building the pipeline that powers our growth across the French enterprise landscape.


What You'll Do

  • Define and execute a territory sales plan for France, driving net new logo acquisition through disciplined prospecting, pipeline development, and strategic account pursuit
  • Run complete, multistakeholder sales cycles end to end, from discovery and qualification through solution design, negotiation, and close, consistently building toward and exceeding your targets
  • Build and manage a high quality pipeline that balances breadth across your enterprise territory with depth in your highest priority opportunities
  • Partner closely with Solutions Engineers, Channel Development, and Rubrik's partner ecosystem to position our data security platform against the full scope of customer risk

title: Sr. Customer Success Manager (French Speaking)
description:
About You
You're a jack-of-all-trades with a passion for cool technology and interacting with people and making them happy. You're a self-starter who's good at triaging problems and working on the most important one. You've worked directly with customers for a long time and are comfortable being the face of the company to them. One of the things that pleases you most in life is customers successfully using your product, being thrilled with its value, and telling you they're happy they partnered with you. Further, you're a curious person, and you'd love the opportunity to work with a technology team that includes data scientists, algorithm experts, back-end and front-end engineers to expand your knowledge.
About Us
 Constructor.io powers product search and discovery for some of the largest retailers in the world. We serve billions of requests every week, and you've probably seen our results somewhere and used our product without knowing it. We differentiate ourselves by focusing on metrics over features, and reinventing search and discovery from the ground up as a machine learning challenge with the specific goal of improving metrics like revenue. We're approximately doubling year over year despite the market slow down and have customers in every eCommerce vertical.
We're a passionate team of technologists who love solving problems and want to make our customers' and coworkers' lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they think is best can lead to great things.
About The Position
As a Customer Success Manager, you'll be joining a rapidly growing team that helps our customers increase their revenue by improving the search and product discovery experiences of their websites and mobile apps through integrating with our services.
